correctness.rationale: All independent faces have support in the five diagonal pairs; transitivity reduces the full orbit to one join, with exact two-element stabilizer. A two-support face forces the stabilizer; a one-support face is compared using the fixed inner labels. The finite compact-Hausdorff quotient is a homeomorphism. Equivariant crosspolytope-to-sphere coordinates diagonalize factor exchange; standard integral RP^d cellular differentials 0,2 give the exact groups. Independent finite orbit checks passed for d=0..3 and group formulas for d=2..8, but unrestricted proof does not rely on these.

value.rationale: The exact orbit-space homeomorphism is a structural statement uniform over arbitrary finite nonempty fiber graphs. It furnishes an infinite natural family whose geometric D5 quotients have calculable integral Z/2 torsion despite torsion-free unquotiented homology, and it separates genuine orbit spaces from naive vertex orbits and from homology-character results.
